title: Fuzzy shard
description: One fuzzy/<lang>.<hash>.json file: a SymSpell-style precomputed deletion dictionary for typo-tolerant matching. See docs/guides/ranking-and-boosts.md#prefix-and-fuzzy-matching.

maxEdits.description: Only 1 is produced by the reference indexer today; the format allows 2 for a future distance-2 dictionary.

deletions.description: Deletion-variant string (a real term with up to maxEdits characters removed, including the term itself at 0 deletions) -> every real term that produced it. Multiple real terms may collide on the same variant.
